title: Why Your Stomach Growls Even When You Squeeze It
caption:
Your stomach growls loudest when you're trying to hide it.
In a silent exam room he squeezes his stomach, begging it to stay quiet - it roars anyway, and he buries his face in his hands.
Those rumbles, borborygmi, are gut muscles sweeping gas and fluid through an empty stomach, so pressing from outside can't mute them.
Has your stomach ever betrayed you at the worst possible moment?
Share this with a friend whose stomach can't keep quiet.
